description: Speed-dependent neutral pedal point with forward drive above neutral and opposing-rotation regen below it. Regen fades to zero at low speed; invalid inputs or settings request zero. No temporal slew.

inputPorts.name: RpmMech
inputPorts.description: Timestamped control mechanical RPM; magnitude sets the neutral and regen curves.

inputPorts.name: RpmElec
inputPorts.description: Sign-corrected electrical RPM; regen current opposes this direction.

outputPorts.name: Iq
outputPorts.description: Blended Iq request before enable gate and DC-link protection.

outputPorts.name: Neutral
outputPorts.description: Neutral throttle fraction (0–1) at the current speed.

outputPorts.name: RegenAvailable
outputPorts.description: Speed-limited regen Iq magnitude before DC-link protection.

RegenAmps.description: Maximum opposing-rotation regen Iq magnitude in amperes.

NeutralMax.description: Neutral pedal fraction at or above NeutralFullRpm; must be >=0 and <1.

NeutralFullRpm.description: Mechanical RPM magnitude where neutral reaches NeutralMax; greater than RegenStartRpm.

RegenStartRpm.description: Mechanical RPM magnitude below which neutral and regen are zero.

RegenFullRpm.description: Mechanical RPM magnitude where full regen becomes available; greater than RegenStartRpm.
